layout.title: Public data acquired, with explicit label limits
layout.notes: Author repository airslab2020/XRF55-repo; public Kaggle RGB/depth/IR release version 6. There are 886,570,077 bytes and 11,840 sixteen-view JPEG inputs. The release README records CC BY-NC 4.0. Numeric subject aliases are conservatively treated as global. Seventeen scene-subject training groups collapse to 15 numeric groups. One test scene and three groups do not represent 240 independent people. Assistant visual review used training clips only. PETS links were unavailable; synthetic and rendered method-output luggage media were rejected. Other exclusions remain in source_audit.json.

layout.title: SmolVLM: prior LoRA does not improve this source
layout.notes: Original AP is 0.3855 versus 0.3573 for LoRA. The existing smoking route is seed 42 / learning rate 0.0001, with 4,341,760 language parameters trained previously. Both development routes were calibrated before any new-source test forward. There is no scene-4 route selection or new fine-tuning. Eight uniform views are the validated prompt maximum; CLIP uses sixteen. Native-versus-cached margin errors are below 0.002. This result concerns scripted action source transfer, not true CCTV smoking accuracy.

layout.title: Full-stream tiling reverses the component gain
layout.notes: Ten recordings are processed from time zero to EOF at 2 Hz: 2,512 images and 12,560 views across three arms. Full-frame views plus four 60% corner tiles use class-wise NMS at IoU 0.5. Item-only tiles retain full-frame person proposals. The unchanged rule requires known ownership, 30 seconds of stationarity, 0.5 seconds of owner absence and two seconds of alarm persistence. Primary normal exposure is 205.739 seconds, or 3.43 minutes; its zero-alert one-sided 95% Poisson upper bound is 52.42/hour. Saved results also align the earlier t >= 20 exposure of 165.739 seconds. Forty added seconds are the same footage. Delay measures onset to alarm, not inference latency.

layout.title: Keep provisional and censored evidence separate
layout.notes: ABODA has five provisional events and 359 normal seconds; full-frame finds 4/5, while each tile arm finds 2/5. These intervals are not independently reviewed. Right-censored HARD remains separate from the two primary events. All three arms detect its annotated interval, but repeated alarms persist; all-tiles adds a normal false alert. MEDIUM item-track IDs increase from 284 to 497 and EASY from 162 to 371, consistent with spurious or fragmented associations. These counts are not ground-truth identity-switch rates. No rule was retuned on these test streams.
